title: Agenomic Coding Action (v0.3)
description: One native tool call of a coding-agent runtime, classified into the Agenomic coding action vocabulary and decided by the governance layer (RFC 0013). decision records what Agenomic answered; status and outcome record what was later observed. An allow decision is not proof of execution. Only enforce binds: observe and shadow always answer defer, and enforce never does; only a shadow action records would_have_been, and only an enforce action references an approval. A blocked action is refused with deny, names its cause in a non-empty reason_codes and requests no approval. input_digest binds an approval to the intent it was granted for.

coding_session_id.description: The coding session the action belongs to (the session object's id). Required, so an action stays attributable when it is stored or exported outside a session-scoped container. (coding_session_id, native_request_id, attempt) is the tool-call correlation key that tool.* events carry as (coding_session_id, payload.native_request_id, attempt_id).

native_request_id.description: The runtime's own id for the call (Claude Code tool_use id, Codex itemId[:approvalId]).

attempt.description: Attempt number of the native call; tool.* events carry it as the decimal string attempt_id.

native_tool.description: Native tool name, for example Bash, Write, Edit, exec_command, apply_patch, mcp__srv__tool.

preview.description: Redacted, size-bounded preview of the native input. Never raw secrets.

input_digest.description: Intent digest (RFC 0013, Approval binding): blake3: plus the lowercase hex BLAKE3 hash of the compact JSON, keys sorted by code point at every level, of {runtime, native_tool, input, cwd, workspace_root, base_revision, patch_digest, sandbox, permission_mode, network_scope, paths, symlink_escapes}, absent values null and absent lists []. Computed by the gateway. An approval is bound to it: a re-submitted call whose recomputed digest differs is refused with input_changed and needs a new request.

patch_digest.description: Digest of the patch a file change applies; part of the intent object behind input_digest.

effective_mode.description: The mode that applied to this call. It can differ from the session's mode_effective: an enforce session yields a shadow action when every contributing policy binding was evaluated in shadow mode, and a call the session cannot govern in its requested mode is blocked.

would_have_been.description: Shadow mode only: what enforce would have returned (allow, deny or pending). Required and non-null on a shadow action, whose decision itself is defer; a would-be pending is recorded here and no approval is requested. On an observe, enforce or blocked action it is null or absent.

toolId.$comment: The closed coding tool vocabulary of RFC 0013. coding-session.schema.json references it for protection.protected and protection.not_covered.

allOf.$comment: A pending decision always references the approval that holds it.
In observe mode Agenomic never blocks: the native permission flow decides, so no approval is requested in Agenomic. would_have_been is shadow-only, so it is null or absent.
Shadow never binds: the answer is defer, what enforce would have returned (allow, deny or pending, never null) goes in the required would_have_been, and no approval is requested.

Enforce binds: the answer is the policy decision (allow, deny or pending), never defer, which would hand the call back to the native permission flow. would_have_been is shadow-only, so it is null or absent.

A blocked action is refused because the session cannot honour its requested mode: the answer is deny, its reason_codes name the cause (for example enforce_prerequisite_missing, or input_changed for a changed re-submission), no approval is requested since no reviewer can lift the block, and would_have_been, which is shadow-only, is null or absent.
